name: CM-LAB Rights & Renewals Agent
description: Autonomous AI agent for sovereign consumer rights defense, contract lifecycle auditing, and statutory warranty enforcement.

skills.name: Search Consumer Rights
skills.description: Searches statutory consumer rights and cancellation terms across Germany, EU, UK, and US.
examples: What is the statutory cooling-off period for online contracts in Germany?
Can I cancel my gym contract if I move away?

skills.name: Generate Claim Dossier
skills.description: Compiles legally binding defect notices under BGB § 437/439 or cancellation letters.
examples: Generate a statutory defect notice for a cracked laptop screen bought 8 months ago.

skills.name: BGB Statutory Period Calculator
skills.description: Calculates statutory warranty deadlines, 12-month burden of proof transition, and notice periods under German BGB.
examples: Calculate the burden of proof cliff date for an iPhone bought on 2024-03-15.
